args.code: const query = `{ entry(entry_id: "1CRN") { rcsb_id rcsb_primary_citation { id title pdbx_database_id_PubMed pdbx_database_id_DOI journal_abbrev journal_volume year page_first page_last } } }`; const r = await fetch('https://data.rcsb.org/graphql?query='+encodeURIComponent(query)); const data = await r.json(); const s = await fetch('https://api.crossref.org/swagger-docs'); const spec = await s.json(); return {rcsbStatus:r.status, data, crossrefSpec:{host:spec.host,basePath:spec.basePath,servers:spec.servers,paths:Object.keys(spec.paths||{}).filter(p=>p.includes('works')&&p.includes('doi'))}};

args.content: Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"1CRN"} (or another four-character PDB entry). Uses only credential-free public reads on data.rcsb.org and api.crossref.org. RCSB's rcsb_primary_citation explicitly identifies the primary publication; Crossref must identify the matching DOI as a journal-article, not a dataset. Checks title (ignoring punctuation/case), publication year, volume and pages. Returns Crossref's exact title array and publisher. Crossref /works/{doi} was discovered from https://api.crossref.org/swagger-docs. Verified 1CRN: DOI 10.1073/pnas.81.19.6014; article published 1984, volume 81, pages 6014-6018. Throws on missing or inconsistent evidence.
